entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: Papers attempting this tactic fail most often by attaching a different conditioning encoder, latent space, or control channel to an existing refinement backbone and presenting the swap itself as the contribution, without isolating it. entries.tactical_pattern_quoted: The shared move is to hold an iterative-refinement generative backbone (diffusion, flow-matching, masked-token, or coarse-to-fine autoregressive prediction) fixed and treat its conditioning interface or operating representation space as the free variable. Concretely, papers do one of three things: change what the procedure conditions on (replace categorical labels with masked surrounding context, a differentiable measured-response objective, a self-supervised feature vector, or pinned start/end states); change how the condition enters (swap one-way frozen injection for bidirectional co-evolving dual streams, route conditioning across spatial regions and refinement stages, restrict the signal to an interval of steps, or partition it by functional subcomponent); or move refinement out of raw output space into a redesigned latent space (disentangled, contrastive, periodic-parameter, or SSL-feature).
